lines.text: Why do Indian temples always have heavy metal bells?
It is not just tradition, it is pure science.
These bells are cast with seven sacred metals,
including copper, silver, zinc and gold.
When struck, the bell produces a distinct acoustic chime
that resonates for exactly seven seconds.
This frequency synchronizes your left and right brain,
clearing all chaotic thoughts in an instant.
So before you pray, your mind becomes completely calm.
Ancient architecture engineered for absolute peace.
